## About
KH Automotive is a family-owned and operated repair shop in Mission, KS. We specialize in European vehicles such as Mercedes Benz, Land Rover, Jaguar and Porsche, and we work on import and domestic cars too, from routine oil changes to the most complex engine problem.
Our owner, Kevin Hinckle, is an ASE certified master technician, and our technicians have training from General Motors, Honda, Porsche, Saab, Audi, Jaguar, Mercedes Benz and Land Rover. One customer wrote that Kevin and Scott have taken care of her Audi for years.
Our bottom line is simple: we believe in providing quality service and clear honest communication for any service need.

## Services
- Engine repair: Engine repair and rebuild.
- Diagnostics: Diagnostics with equipment including Snap-On Verus Edge, Mercedes SDS, Vag-Com and others.
- Routine oil changes: Routine oil changes for your car.
- Automatic and manual transmission repair: Repair for both automatic and manual transmissions.
- Cooling systems: Water pumps, radiators, hoses and belts.
- Brakes, steering, suspension: Brake, steering and suspension work.
- Heating/air conditioning: Heater cores, compressors and more.
- Electrical: Electrical repairs including starters and alternators.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: We specialize in European vehicles such as Mercedes Benz, Land Rover, Jaguar and Porsche, and we also handle import and domestic repair.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Call us at 913-403-0073 and we'll get you on the schedule.
